# Inwoovation Precision CEA & AgTech Engineering Portal (inwoovation.com)

> Institutional-grade open engineering portal for Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA), Venlo glasshouse structural & thermodynamic design, psychrometric microclimate steering, global 8-country agricultural grant intelligence, and European/North American/East Asian horticultural economics.

## Core Flagship Engineering Suites
- [Global 8-Country 3-Tier Agri-Subsidy & Grant Navigator v6.0 (150 Verified Programs)](https://inwoovation.com/tools/global-agri-subsidy-grant-navigator.html): Federal, State/Provincial, and Municipal agricultural & greenhouse grant database covering the United States (80), Germany (20), Japan (11), Netherlands (11), South Korea (8), France (7), Spain (7), and Canada (6) with 100% statutory 3-step application playbooks and CSV/JSON export.
- [VenloCAD 3D v3.2 Parametric CAD & Structural Engine](https://inwoovation.com/tools/venlocad-3d.html): WebGL 3D parametric greenhouse structural engine (NEN 3859 / DIN EN 13031-1 wind & snow load, coupled ATU semi-closed thermodynamics, 1D aluminum bin-packing, DXF/STL/GLB export, and multi-currency CPQ PDF generator).
- [Greenhouse Dynamic Electricity Tariff, BESS & Power-to-Heat (P2H) Arbitrage Calculator](https://inwoovation.com/tools/greenhouse-energy-tariff-bess-p2h-arbitrage-calculator.html): Day-ahead EPEX/JEPX/CAISO spot electricity optimization coupling LiFePO4 battery storage, industrial heat pumps, CHP cogeneration, and sensible thermal buffer tanks.
- [EU Greenhouse Energy Audit (DIN V 18599 / BLE 40%) & Hofnachfolge ROI Simulator](https://inwoovation.com/tools/eu-greenhouse-energy-hofnachfolge-roi-simulator.html): German federal energy efficiency grant (BLE 40%), BEHG/ETS-2 carbon tax abatement, and 10-year farm succession (Ertragspacht / Stille Beteiligung) buyout financial modeler.
- [Deutscher Gartenbau-Meister & KTBL-Standard Hub](https://inwoovation.com/meister.html): KTBL Deckungsbeitrag (DB I & II), DIN V 18599 heating load, QS-GAP 2026 / ToBRFV disinfection, and German Master Horticulturist (Gärtnermeister) examination tools.
- [Master 42 Enterprise CEA Calculators Directory](https://inwoovation.com/tools/): Complete suite of 42 zero-latency browser calculators covering VPD, Mollier psychrometrics, Penman-Monteith evapotranspiration, Hoagland/Sonneveld nutrient stoichiometry, ATES geothermal storage, BESS/P2H arbitrage, and MPC climate control.
- [Complete 360-Page CEA Engineering HTML Directory](https://inwoovation.com/directory.html): Single-page crawlable index of all 360 calculators, subsidies, multilingual monographs, crop guides, wiki modules, and climate hubs.

## Multilingual Engineering Monographs & Encyclopedias
- [178 Multilingual Engineering Monographs (78 EN · 61 DE · 39 JA)](https://inwoovation.com/guides.html): Comprehensive research library covering greenhouse thermodynamics, stomatal conductance, autonomous AI reinforcement learning (MPC), high-wire crop steering, German Gärtnermeister Series (Vol. 01–61 complete), and Japanese smart horticulture.
- [AgTech Botanical & Biochemical Wiki (44 Modules)](https://inwoovation.com/wiki/): Deep physiological references on Rubisco kinetics, PIP aquaporin gating, calcium xylem transport, and crop-specific steering.
- [Global Greenhouse Climate Atlas (40 Regional Hubs)](https://inwoovation.com/climate/): Empirical monthly solar DLI, heating degree-days, and structural design benchmarks across Westland (NL), Bleiswijk (NL), Straelen (DE), Knoblauchsland/Nürnberg (DE), Almería (ES), Leamington (CA), Tsukuba (JP), Salinas (US), and Gimje (KR).
- [Commercial Crop Steering Atlas (10 Crops)](https://inwoovation.com/crops/): Phenological VPD, DLI, and root-zone EC/WC% targets for Tomato, Cucumber, Sweet Pepper, Strawberry, Lettuce, Rose, Phalaenopsis, Basil, Eggplant, and Medicinal Crops.
- [Deutscher Meisterfunk Podcast (Daily 2-Host Neural Audio & Transcripts)](https://inwoovation.com/podcasts/): Daily German horticultural science and economics dialogue podcast with validated RSS feed (`https://inwoovation.com/podcasts/feed.xml`).
